식당.name: Cafeteria
식당.comment: The cafeteria opens from the 2nd blovk. The food is so popular that you can't eat if you go late.

조깅하기.name: Jogging
조깅하기.comment: I often want to get some fresh air after being indoors. Let's go out for a quick jog.

도서관.name: Library
도서관.comment: There's a large library on the 2nd floor. It's quiet and easy to focus, but... you have to climb the stairs.

강의실.name: Lecture Room
강의실.comment: Due to lack of space, the lecture room is never empty. Someone will always be there.

정문.name: Main Gate
정문.comment: This is the path I always take to get here. Sometimes I can see cat Bongwon outside the gate.

동아리방.name: Club Room
동아리방.comment: It's the most comfortable place. Fitting for a game dev club, there are 4 gaming PCs.

헬스하기.name: Working Out
헬스하기.comment: I work out for a healthy body and mind. Lately, I've been getting interested in lifting weights.

편의점.name: Convenience Store
편의점.comment: It's a relatively easy job. I like this convenience store because it's not crowded.

택배.name: Delivery Work
택배.comment: It pays well, but it's very hard work. The fatigue will likely last until the next day...

침대.name: Bed
침대.comment: This is my bed. After a good sleep, I'll be able to start tomorrow with more energy.

책상.name: Desk
책상.comment: At this rate, I might get academic probation. I need to do some studying...

강아지.name: Puppy
강아지.comment: My cute doggy Chamkkae. I'm sorry for leaving her home alone for so long. I should play with her now.

태블릿.name: Tablet PC
태블릿.comment: I worked hard today, so I'll watch some anime in bed. Deciding what to watch is the hard part, though.

상점.name: School Store
상점.comment: The school store. You can buy all kinds of stuff here.
